name: cli-transcript-render
description: M22 Wave 0: rich payloads on the cli surface, pinned as they render TODAY. Two todo_add turns emit TodoList rows and the edit_file turn emits a Diff row (write_file creating a brand-new file emits none — no before-content to diff, also pinned here); the delivery loop hands all of them to a bare (non-rich) adapter, so every structured payload is flattened to text via the ChannelAdapter trait defaults — exactly the flattening the real CliAdapter performs for chat.log. The expected delivered stream is the byte baseline Wave 1's A5 structured-JSONL cli output will diff against. Since Wave 3's D5, cli takes Behavior::Transcript (capabilities::renders_client_side_transcript): the Task HUD emits every frame as a fresh Breadcrumb EVENT (batch-start/batch-end frames with cumulative steps, then the done-collapse) and never an update_breadcrumb edit — cclaw chat dedupes and repaints client-side. Runs under a re-exec'd child with COPPERCLAW_DATA_ROOT set (the todo store path resolves through it) — see replay.rs. See README.md.
